scope: new internal shipping component; no additional registered HTTP route

axes.prdBusinessId: PRD V2.1-R4 §8.2 / WX-PAY-MAKE-01; unified physical parcel shipping synchronization, not receipt or financial completion
axes.identity: prepare and pre-dispatch recheck current actor via AuthorityService; recovery is internal and not an HTTP entry
axes.roleCapability: commerce.fulfillment.manage; revocation before dispatch is tested; transport grant is denied by default
axes.objectRow: paid verified_commerce order; unique proposal per order; exact applied full_cash payment identity and amount; unresolved refunds/composition observations block
axes.fieldProjection: id/orderId/state/queryAttempts only; parcel encrypted AES-GCM with id/order/key-version AAD; no raw upstream errors or access-token URL
axes.actionState: prepared→dispatching→verifying→synced/manual_review; query matching can recognize prior completed upload; no automatic reupload after dispatch
axes.environment: no HTTP/worker composition or live grant installed; synthetic transport tests only; no real funds; staging ae314 does not contain this code
axes.inputBoundary: UUID/request/evidence identifiers; trimmed bounded UTF-8 parcel values; masked SF contact; canonical persisted RFC3339 time; bounded upstream JSON
axes.idempotencyVersion: actor/request HMAC and order uniqueness; immutable proposal and dispatched_at; no terminal rewrites; no manual-redrive facility yet
axes.concurrency: database claim token, one-minute lease, SKIP LOCKED; dispatch committed before network; refund/authority rechecked before dispatch; stale claims cannot finalize
axes.databaseExternalEffects: one proposal/audit row; irreversible dispatch marker; fixed official query/upload URLs, TLS redirects denied; no local receipt/refund/commission state write
axes.limitsTimeoutPagination: 15s outbound dependency budget, 64KiB response, max5 query attempts and bounded backoff; no scheduling/list HTTP endpoint yet
axes.positiveNegativeEvidence: unit transport/payload/binding/error cases; real isolated PG tests unauthorized/unpaid/replay/conflict/encryption/concurrent claim/uncertain upload/crash recovery/revocation; official production platform not called

remaining: live platform binding and permitted acceptance
